# Environnement


Librairies


```{r}
library(sf)
library(mapsf)
library(mapview)
```






# données



```{r}
data <- st_read("c:/Users/bmaranget/Downloads/LCZ_SPOT_2022_Paris.shp")
bondy <- st_read("../data/limitesSocle.gpkg", "bondy")
```

Une source très complète


![](img/ICU_cerema.png)


# Inter

```{r}
inter <- st_intersection(data, bondy)
summary(inter)
mf_map(inter, var = "lcz_int", type = "choro")
```


# Carto sur toutes les variables



```{r}
var <- names(inter)
var <- var [c(2:10)]
titre <- c("Hauteur bâti", "Superficie bâti", "Tx surface bâtie", "Tx surface minéral", "Tx sol nu perméable", "Tx surf eau", "Tx végétation", "Part arbres sur végétation", "LCZ")
tmp <- inter [,var [1]]
v <- var [1]
png("../img/lcz.png", width = 6000, height = 6000, res = 1000)
par(mfrow  = c(3,3))
for (v in var) {
  print(v)
  ind <- which(v==var)
  t <- titre [ind]
  tmp <- inter [,v]
  class(tmp [,v, drop = T])
  if (is.numeric(tmp [,v, drop = T]) ) {
    mf_map(tmp, var = v, type="choro")
    mf_layout(t, "Janvier 2026")
  } else {
    mf_map(tmp, var = v, type="typo")
    mf_layout(t, "Janvier 2026")
  }
}
dev.off()
```

Enregistrement


```{r}
st_write(inter,"../data/icu.gpkg", "cerema2024", delete_layer = T)
```
